notes: The power watchdog now also catches a key already stuck on when the 24 V comes on, such as a shorted switch on a key board. The tablet remembers the plug's usual draw from its last few power-ups; if a power-up starts more than about half a key's draw above it, the tablet looks again a second later, then switches the 24 V off ("The 24 V draws N W more than usual with nothing playing — 24 V cut") and the safety check runs before the next piece. If the 24 V supply is ever replaced and its normal draw is higher, forget and re-pair the power plug once.
